card.name: Skarn the Unchained
card.effectText:
Charge, Pierce, Reckless
Whenever Skarn the Unchained attacks, create 2 1A/1D frenzied brute tokens exhausted and attacking. (Place a fatigue token on each one.)
card.effectSource: Brute Mono Deck — Clan of the Broken Fist (Command Siege).docx

printed.costSource: Brute Mono Deck — Clan of the Broken Fist (Command Siege).docx

cards.rationale: Retain a clear combat/token finisher at six total Essence. With the Keep, a first unblocked attack is normally 7 from Skarn plus 1 from each created attacking token, not 11: the new tokens were not declared attackers and do not trigger the Keep attack bonus.
gates: Test blocked and unblocked attacks, Pierce, further attacks and token pumps. Do not assume Reckless fully pays for the attack trigger.

card.name: Royal Crusher
card.effectText:
Siege, Pierce
When Royal Crusher enters the Frontline, up to three Nobles you control get Fortify 2.
card.effectSource: Noble Mono Deck — The Crown’s Might (Command Siege).docx

printed.costSource: Noble Mono Deck — The Crown’s Might (Command Siege).docx

cards.rationale: Retain the dedicated Siege finisher. Four Oath cannot be discounted by Command; Crusher has no printed Charge. It can Fortify itself to 6/9 and up to two other Nobles, so its immediate board payoff still needs testing.
gates: Measure attacks by already-present Nobles after its entry. Ring can supply generic costs but not its four Oath.

card.name: Korgath, Lord of Ruin
card.effectText:
Charge, Relentless
Whenever a Brute you control dies, Korgath, Lord of Ruin deals 1 damage to each Command Station.
card.effectSource: Brute Mono Deck — Clan of the Broken Fist (Command Siege).docx

printed.costSource: Brute Mono Deck — Clan of the Broken Fist (Command Siege).docx

cards.rationale: Test seven total Essence for Charge, Relentless and a death-pulse engine on a 6/5. It threatens damage on entry-turn attacks and on destruction; it is a different archetype payoff rather than a mandatory second starter boss.
gates: Test modified last-known Attack for Relentless, self-death pulse, sacrifice chains and simultaneous Station defeat.
Reprice Korgath’s Call alongside Korgath; a higher creature cost must not leave the old free-deployment route as the cheap burst route.

card.name: Seraphine, Royal Advisor
card.effectText:
Command
At the start of your turn, if you Planned or Refined last turn, you may deploy a Noble with cost 5 or less from your hand without paying its cost.
card.effectSource: Noble Mono Deck — The Crown’s Might (Command Siege).docx

printed.costSource: Noble Mono Deck — The Crown’s Might (Command Siege).docx

cards.rationale: Test six total Essence with a three-Oath floor under Command. At printed cost six, Seraphine no longer qualifies for her own cost-five-or-less free deployment. The starter still retains cheaper Plan/Fortify engines.
gates: Cost-five-or-less must use printed cost, not Command-discounted cost.

Current Start jobs resolve before Ready, so a Unit deployed by Seraphine can be readied in that same Start Phase. Test or deliberately change this timing; do not assume an extra turn of deployment fatigue.
Test multiple Seraphines without assuming an unimplemented one-Legendary rule.

card.name: Garrett of Ashenfield
card.effectText:
Command
When Garrett of Ashenfield enters the Frontline, all Nobles you control get Fortify 1.
Whenever a Noble you control deals damage to a Command Station, Garrett of Ashenfield deals 1 damage to any target.
card.effectSource: Noble Mono Deck — The Crown’s Might (Command Siege).docx

printed.costSource: Noble Mono Deck — The Crown’s Might (Command Siege).docx

cards.creatorDecision: November 6, 2026: original wording and self-retriggering Station-damage interaction are intentional. Preserve them; no trigger rewrite.
cards.rationale: Retain seven total Essence with a three-Oath Command floor as a test price for an intentional combo finisher. Its accessibility, supporting cost reduction and available disruption must be tested together; the price is not a claim of established balance.
gates: Preserve original wording and self-triggering behavior.
Test legal response windows, removal of the source, entry Fortify, multiple attackers and multiple Garretts.
Review future Command support and cost reduction together with this price; do not assess only nominal cost.
